keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Cho Hyun-Taek (Korea Republic) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Saudi Arabia 1, Korea Republic 0. Marwan Al Sahafi (Saudi Arabia) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Abdullah Al Hamddan.
Substitution, Korea Republic. Lee Myung-Jae replaces Cho Hyun-Taek.
Substitution, Saudi Arabia. Saud Abdulhamid replaces Mohammed Al Qahtani.
Substitution, Saudi Arabia. Abdullah Al Salem replaces Abdullah Al Hamddan.
Goal! Saudi Arabia 1, Korea Republic 1. Oh Hyeon-Gyu (Korea Republic) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Seol Young-Woo.
Mohamed Kanno (Saudi Arabia) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Saudi Arabia 2, Korea Republic 1. Mohamed Kanno (Saudi Arabia) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Saud Abdulhamid.
